analysis: Market context: Portfolio is well-positioned with 4 quality names (ADSK, APP, MSFT, V) consuming ~88% of equity. All current holdings are in confirmed uptrend-basing patterns and within 1% of entry — no thesis breaks, no exits warranted. Available cash is ~$11.3K (~11% of equity). The screened list offers 30 candidates but most are MIXED/SIDEWAYS with negative SMA50 slopes — not ideal Stage 1→2 entries. A few standouts: UBER is at just 20% of its 52-week range with a confirmed uptrend basing pattern, not extended above SMA50 (+1.6%), and SMA50 slope turning positive — a textbook low-risk entry. Fundamentals are compelling: $6.5B FCF, 35.3% ROE, dominant platform duopoly in ride-share and delivery, P/E 18.7x is cheap for this quality. AFL and NTAP are near 52w highs (80-82% range) — too extended for the strategy. AMP and RJF have negative SMA50 slopes — not confirmed basing yet. CEG has good momentum but higher ATR at 4.5% makes position sizing tight with limited cash. UBER wins on combination of range position, trend quality, and fundamental value. Adding as a 5th position uses the available cash constructively without violating any hard rules. Position is sized by available cash (~150 shares), slightly below the formula-optimal size but appropriate given the cash constraint. Portfolio heat remains controlled at ~2.5% total after this addition.

trades.entry_strategy: Limit order at $75.00 or better during intraday consolidation near SMA50. If price gaps up above $77, wait for a pullback to $75-76 before entering. No chasing.
trades.rationale: FUNDAMENTAL: Uber is the dominant two-sided platform in mobility and food delivery — near-impossible to replicate network effects. FCF of $6.5B growing rapidly, ROE 35.3%, and a P/E of 18.7x is inexpensive for a business with this competitive moat and optionality (autonomous vehicle partnerships, advertising, freight). Revenue growing 14.5% with improving margins. TECHNICAL: Price is at just 20% of its 52-week range ($69.18-$100.10) — deep value territory technically. Confirmed UPTREND basing with SMA50 slope turning positive (+0.7%), price only +1.6% above SMA50 (not extended), and SMA200 only -11% away. This is the Stage 1→2 transition entry the strategy targets. ATR-based stop at 1.75x sits at $70.38, just below recent lows, giving the trade room to breathe without excessive risk.
trades.exit_plan: Exit if: (1) price closes below stop $70.38 on volume (stop hit); (2) SMA50 slope turns decisively negative for 3+ weeks without recovery (trend break); (3) revenue growth decelerates below 8% or FCF margins compress materially (fundamental break); (4) price reaches $93 target — reassess for continuation vs. trim; (5) time stop: if no progress after 3 months and thesis unclear, exit to redeploy. Prefer to hold toward LTCG if thesis intact past 11 months.
